tei:div.tei:p: na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ /rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rdo rjo 'dzin/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub stsol/ /rje btsun klu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /mnga' bdag bi su kalba dang*/ /grub chen sa ra ha pa la/ /gsol ba= /rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub zhabs/ /de sras thu bo zla ba grags/ /grub mchog slob pa'i rdo rje la/ /gsol ba= /brtul zhugs mchog spyod nag po pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug sprin shugs can/ /sgra bsgyur 'gos lo chen po la/ /gsol pa= /rgyal sras seṅge rgyal mtshan dang*/ /rim gnyis mngon gyur ye shes seng*/ /mkhas mchog ār+ya de ba la/ /gsol ba= /rgyud don gsal mdzad nyi ma lcam/ /zab don mngon gyur rin chen grags/ /mchog brnyes tshul khrims skyabs nyid la/ /gsol ba= /mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa skyabs/ /gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin gzhon nu 'od/ /kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer la/ /gsol ba= /nus pa phul phyin 'phags pa 'od/ /rje btsun bu ston rin chen grub/ /mkhas grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba= sgra bsgyur chen po nam mkha' bzang*/ /mnyam med rje btsun re mda' ba/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha par/ /gsol ba= /smra ba'i nyi ma mkhas grub rje/ /'dus pa'i bka' babs sher seng sogs/ /lam 'di'i dngos brgyud bla ma la/ /gsol ba= /de ltar gso ba btab pa'i mthus/ /skye ba kun du rjes bzung ste/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /go 'phang mchog de myur thong shog /ces gsang ba 'dus pa'i bla brgyud rim pa gnyis las rgyas sras blo gros rin chen nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'don pa da lta dar che yang*/ phyag na rdo rje nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs phyogs 'dir ma dar 'dug pas/ de dar na snyam du bsams te bshad sgrub ming can gyis bris pa'o// /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru mañju gho ṣa ya/

bde ba'i mchog gyur lhan skyes gcig pu nyid/ /dam tshig sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /rab 'byams 'khor lo lnga yi lha tshogs su/ /sprul mdzad he ru ka dpal zhabs la 'dud du/ /gdul bya'i rgyud la lhan skyes bde ba che/ /rgyas par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas pa ni/ /bsgrub phyir nyid sku yid 'phrog mdzes ma'i skur/ /sprul pa'i rje btsun ma yis rtag tu skyongs/ /gsang ba kun 'dzin rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag / grub mchog sa ra ha dang lū hi ba/ /dā ri ka dang dril bu'i zhabs la sogs/ /sgrub chen bla ma rnams la= /rgyal ba kun dngos rje btsun tsong kha pa/ /de sras thu bo mkhas grub dge legs dpal/ /lam 'di srol 'dzin zla med chos kyi rje/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhabs la= /rnal 'byor dbang phyug du mas bgrod gyur ba'i/ / 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim gnyis zab mo'i lam/ /bshad sgrub gnyis kyis tshul bzhin 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la=/ / ༈ mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge dang*/ /de sras thu bo kun dga' don grub sogs/ /'dus pa'i dbang bskur bshad srol man ngag gi/ /dngos rgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun tsong kha ba'i/ /legs bshad dbyar rnga dad ba'i dbyu gu yis/ /legs bskul grags pa'i sgra dbyangs cher sgrogs pa/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa'i mgon la gsol 'debs/ /khyad par rgyud sde stong phrag so gsum dang*/ /chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi rtsa/ /mthar drug tshul bzhi'i rgyas btab rgyud kyi rgyal/ /'dzin mdzad rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*/ /'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*/ /sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/bla rgyud bzhugs/
